meta.title: Chocobanana Mail Club
meta.description: Chocobanana is a cozy mail club sending little sweets of joy through the post.

brand.name: Chocobanana
brand.tagline: A cozy little mail club for soft stationery, handwritten moments, and parcels that feel like a hug in the post.

mailClub.title: The Mail Club
mailClub.body: Chocobanana began with a simple wish: to make getting mail feel magical again. The Mail Club is where that wish lives — thoughtful stationery, playful details, and the quiet joy of something made just for opening slowly.

steps.title: Browse the Club
steps.text: Wander through the Mail Club and see what kinds of sweet parcels we dream up.

steps.title: Choose Your Favorites
steps.text: Pick the stationery and keepsakes that feel most like you — soft, playful, and a little nostalgic.

steps.title: Open the Mail
steps.text: When something arrives, settle in with a cup of something warm and enjoy the little ritual of opening mail.

shop.title: From the Shop
shop.intro: Stationery pieces and a monthly Mail Club option. Catalog prices are set in CAD on the server; checkout opens on Stripe.

letterSets.name: Letter Sets
letterSets.note: Soft paper, gentle lines, and room to write something kind.

stickerSheets.name: Sticker Sheets
stickerSheets.note: Tiny stars, pink hearts, and doodles ready to dress up an envelope.

sealingTouches.name: Sealing Touches
sealingTouches.note: Wax seals and ribbon details for parcels that feel handmade.

keepsakeNotes.name: Keepsake Notes
keepsakeNotes.note: Small cards meant to tuck into a letter or leave on a desk.

about.title: About Chocobanana
about.p1: Chocobanana grew from late-night letter writing, scrapbook scraps, and a soft spot for anything that feels handmade. We believe the post can still carry warmth — a sticker, a note, a carefully chosen paper — reminders that someone thought of you.
about.p2: The kitten with the golden star is our little guardian of cozy mail days. Everything we make aims for that same feeling: sweet, a bit nostalgic, and gently playful.

footer.credit: Made with soft paper & golden stars.
